ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: Menu Shell
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
The campaign's menu and loading-screen shell, per design/Jawa/worldbuilding/ui_appearance_spec.md section 2 and 5.
Ships two things, both XML/texture only (no C#, no Harmony):
(1) VBE.BackgroundImageDef backgrounds for Vanilla Backgrounds Expanded's main-menu picker (which the loading screen inherits for free) - the pantheon slide, letterboxed onto a 2560x1440 indigo-black field with no upscaling, plus one background per god icon (nine), each the god's icon large on the same indigo field. All ten are MayRequire="vanillaexpanded.backgrounds" so they are skipped cleanly if VBE is ever dropped - RimWorld checks MayRequire before it even tries to resolve the def's C# type, so no red error either way. A Tier-1 fallback ships alongside: the same pantheon composite at Textures/UI/HeroArt/BGPlanet.png, which overrides Core's own planet background by load order alone (ContentFinder's last-mod-wins walk) with zero dependency on VBE.
(2) RUT_TipSet_Jawa - a TipSetDef of ~30 Jawa-voiced loading tips (lore, doctrine, one-line jokes), read automatically by GameplayTipWindow alongside vanilla's own tips during the long cold load.
Not built here (see the spec and UI_APPEARANCE_BUILD_1's filing note): the temple-ship hero render (Image A - needs a commissioned piece), the desert-vista second image, and the title wordmark (a taste ruling for the owner, carded, not decided).
